notes.title: Big Update from "Devoid of Shadows" !!!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29517474/42c527dbc58e5812e5e9c5c0e8afd9727114f6cd.png
1.  A new image for Celina. New appearance, costume and animation. She’s even more charming and dangerous!
2.  Increased performance of FPS.
3.  Improved combat system. 
4.  Improved AI of enemies. 
5.  Automatic camera movement implemented.
6.  Views of ranged and close-up cameras improved. 
7.  Monster balance refined.
8.  More detailed training on crafts in the Castle added.
9.  Tutorial for Scrolls, Potions, Weapons and Armor added. 
10.Tutorial on Skills added.
11. Effects for Skills, Potions and Scrolls improved.
12. Sound for locations improved.
13. Physics of objects corrected.
14. Atmospherity of locations improve.
15. Brighter backlight for NPC added.
16. Arrows that point to the NPC if dialogue is necessary were added.
17. Models of some mobs and NPC were replaced.
18. Animation for the main characters and monsters were updated/added.
19. Hero Healing speed increased.
20. Effect notifying about dealt damage was added.
21. Various bugs fixed.
Updates for the remaining languages will be published as soon as they are ready.

notes.title: Update released!
Update released!
Update and discount today!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

We are happy to announce that today at the 10.00am (pacific time) update for Devoid of Shadows will be released! We worked hard to fix the bugs and make a number of improvements. Thanks for the support of our community! We took into account and implemented a number of wishes, proposed by the players. And we hope that you will like the updated game!

Also, in honor of the release of the update, the cost of the game will be reduced by 60%!

notes.title: Update and discount next week!
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

We are happy to inform, that on the next week global update for Devoid of Shadows will be released. We fully replaced pathfinding system for heroes and monsters, added hotkeys, new animations for heroes, updated battle system and fixed a lot of bugs. And we added new English localization too. Now we are completeting testing and preparing to release new build for all of you!

Also, on the occasion of the Devoid of Shadows updated version release, the cost of the game will be reduced by 60%!

notes.title: Major news about patch
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

Now, we are happy to  inform all of you, that the our work on the patch for Devoid of Shadows is nearing completion. We did a lot of work and made many changes on the base of the community comments. First of all, this concerns, of course, localization. We create fully new localization and we hope that you will be satisfied. Also, we made other changes and fixes. We create new pathfinding system, new animations, we improved performance of the camera, UI, added hot keys. We bring to your attention this small WIP-video (from Russian version). It demonstrates some of the improvements listed. Enjoy watching!

Yours, ArsLogica team

https://youtu.be/fMFrOmLVeXE
